notes: Registration depends on the vehicle's original list price and age and is not included; use the state's registration fee calculator. The state page is not indexed until this is modeled.
The trade-in credit applies to dealer purchases and is limited to a set amount that the state publishes each year.
Recreation Passport ($15) and plate transfer fees are optional and not included.

content.intro: {state} charges {stateRate} sales tax on a vehicle, a title fee, and a yearly registration fee based on the vehicle's list price. Electric vehicles pay an additional yearly fee.

howItWorks.text: The sales tax rate is {stateRate}. When you buy from a licensed dealer, a trade-in lowers the taxable price, but only up to a yearly limit set by the state.
The title fee is charged once when the vehicle is transferred into your name.

The registration fee is a share of the vehicle's list price when it was new, and it falls over the next few years. This calculator does not include it, because the state's percentages could not be confirmed. The state has its own fee calculator.
Electric vehicles pay an extra yearly fee on top of registration, and plug-in hybrids pay a smaller one.

faq.q: Does a trade-in lower the sales tax in Michigan?
faq.text: Yes, when you buy from a licensed dealer, up to a limit the state sets each year.

faq.q: Why is the registration fee not in the total?
faq.text: It depends on the vehicle's original list price. The state's percentage table could not be confirmed, so it is shown as not included.
Yes. They pay an extra yearly fee in addition to registration.

faq.q: Is there a local sales tax on vehicles?
faq.text: The state pages list a single state rate and no local vehicle tax.
